name: Important features of culture
purpose: What is culture and what does it do?

parts.label: Shared
points: By all or almost all members

parts.label: Learned
points: Older members pass it on to newcomers

parts.label: Systematic
points: A coherent whole, not random habits

example: Conversation styles: Japan/Finland pause, UK waits, Mediterranean interrupts – none is “right”.

name: Schein's three levels of organisational culture
purpose: How to analyse the culture of an organisation?
apply: Give at least two case facts per level
Check coherence: do artifacts and enacted values confirm espoused values?
Conclude on strength and fit of the culture
example: Enron: tower and bonuses · espoused integrity vs enacted “win” · “we are the smartest”.
